items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: And when he got out of the Army I gave him some gigs. Then we made some records

ctx.x: Well, we had a light feud going on, which was unexpected to me because, by me letting him sit in when he was in the army, like Charlie Parker -- same thing, no different. He used to come round, he could play, brought his horn, let him play. But he was in the Army. And when he got out of the Army I gave him some gigs. Then we made some records, I think it was ... [Old Black Magic] ... Anyhow we made it on Atlantic records and it was a hit and John's solo sold -- and we had the biggest feud and arguments because he…
